label: Early copy-phase step (recall of 2nd original token) in long sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely at the step just after the delimiter output, i.e. where the input is the fed-back first original token and the model outputs original token 1 (recall_idx==1, 89% of activation mass). Rate there increases steeply with sequence length: rare for L<=5, ~50% overall, and near-always for L>=7. A weaker second activation appears at recall_idx==2 (11% of mass), mainly for L=9. Magnitude is largest at recall_idx 1 in long sequences (top examples are L=9, with recall_idx 2 at ~0.2-0.6 of max); token identity has only a small effect (digits and repeated tokens slightly higher). Never fires in the original phase, on the delimiter step, at recall_idx 0, or at recall_idx >= 3.

issues: Overclaim: the explanation says the unit fires on 'nearly all' recall_idx==1 steps for L>=7. On dev it fires on 76% of them at L=7, 98% at L=8 and 100% at L=9. L=7 alone carries most of the predicate's false positives.

The recall_idx==2 clause is only 60% precise at L=9. It also leaves out a matching tail at recall_idx==2, L=8, where the unit fires on 24% of steps (2% of activation mass). Likewise recall_idx==1, L=6 fires on 25% of steps (2.3% of mass) and is missed. These misses are systematic, not scattered noise, but they are low in magnitude. Firing rate falls off smoothly as L - recall_idx shrinks, and it is lower at recall_idx 2 than at recall_idx 1, so the hard L cutoffs are an approximation of a graded effect.

There is a mild token-composition effect that the explanation only hints at: sequences with more digits fire more often in the borderline cells (recall_idx 1, L=7: 89% with 2 or more digits vs 67% with none; recall_idx 2, L=9: 70% vs 49%). Adding this to the predicate does not improve test F1 (0.8475 vs 0.8465).
The label mentions only the recall of the 2nd original token, while the predicate also includes recall_idx 2 at L=9 (about 9-11% of activation mass). This is a minor underspecification.
skeptic.revised_label: Early copy-phase step (mainly recall of 2nd original token, weaker for 3rd) in long sequences; firing rate grows with L
